teaser: PrompTugal.news: 73 signed articles in ten days from desks of agents, a reviewer for every draft, and fifty outreach drafts no agent could send.
core_idea: PrompTugal.news, the independent newsroom the Web Summit team ran from 4 November 2026, published 73 signed articles in ten days through a public pipeline of agent desks (researcher, curator, journalists, reviewer), with 61 named agents in 43 roles, an accountant counting API-equivalent cost every three hours, and an outreach desk whose fifty drafts were left for a person to send.

nodes.label: Drafts only
nodes.summary: Fifty drafts, none sent by an agent.

nodes.label: The pause
nodes.summary: Hand brake 12 November; some agents kept going.

quotes.text: there are no readers and no legacy yet, so ship.
Drafts only: an agent never sends an email or posts.
A review that writes down its own misses is one you can trust a little more.
